Terms of use

By using this site you agree to these terms. Read them to understand the nature of the content, the limits of liability and permitted use.

Acceptance of terms

Your use of Massar Services constitutes acceptance of these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. We may update the terms, and continued use after publication counts as acceptance of the updated version.

Nature of the service

The site is an independent information platform offering explainers and articles about Massar services and education in Morocco. It is not:

  • An official website of the Ministry of National Education.
  • A registration or account platform.
  • A service for issuing results or documents.
  • A substitute for the school or the administrative body.
  • A legal or financial advisory service.

We do not guarantee that the content is complete or up to date at every moment. Information can change, and we say so when we can.

Permitted use

You may:

  • Read the content and share links to it.
  • Use it for personal or non-commercial educational purposes.
  • Quote short extracts with attribution to the source.

You may not:

  • Republish the content in full or sell it without permission.
  • Use the site name or logo in a way that suggests official status or partnership.
  • Attempt to break into or disrupt the site.
  • Send spam or unlawful content through the form.
  • Harvest user data or crawl the site automatically in a way that harms the service.
  • Impersonate the editorial team or an official body.

Intellectual property

The original content, design, logos and visual files on this site are protected by intellectual property law unless stated otherwise. Platform names and official trademarks remain the property of their owners.

Links to external sites do not imply ownership, sponsorship or endorsement by those bodies.

User responsibility

You are responsible for:

  • The accuracy of information you send through the contact form.
  • Not sending personal data or secrets we do not need.
  • Respecting the rights of others when quoting or sharing.
  • Checking official information before making a decision.

Do not send a password, a Massar code or a verification code. The site does not ask for them and is not responsible for you sharing them elsewhere.

External links

The site contains links to official websites or references. We do not control their content, availability or policies. When you follow them, their own terms and privacy policies apply.

Service availability

We try to keep the site available, but interruptions may occur for technical reasons, maintenance or circumstances beyond our control. We do not guarantee continued access to any page or service.

Limits of liability

To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for:

  • Any decision taken in reliance on the site's content without official verification.
  • Any error or omission in the information.
  • Any interruption or technical failure.
  • Any content on a linked external site.
  • Any unlawful use of the site by another user.

This does not exclude liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Changes

We may modify the content, terms or features at any time. We will publish the last update date. If a change is significant we will try to make it clear, but reviewing the page remains your responsibility when relying on sensitive information.

Applicable law

These terms are governed by Moroccan law, subject to mandatory rules that protect the user. Any dispute is referred to the competent court in accordance with the law.

Contact

For any question about these terms, use the contact page. Do not send your account details.
